business_summary: China Zenith Chemical Group Limited, an investment holding company, manufactures and sells calcium carbide and agriculture chemical products in the People's Republic of China. It produces and sells of vinyl acetate and polyvinyl-chloride. The company also provides administrative and consultancy services, as well as manufactures and sells of mining products. The company was formerly known as Xinyang Maojian Group Limited and changed its name to China Zenith Chemical Group Limited in April 2022. China Zenith Chemical Group Limited was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 China Zenith Chemical Group Limited는 중화인민공화국에서 탄화칼슘 및 농약 제품을 제조 및 판매합니다. 초산비닐, 폴리염화비닐을 생산, 판매하고 있습니다. 또한 회사는 관리 및 컨설팅 서비스를 제공할 뿐만 아니라 광산 제품을 제조 및 판매합니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Xinyang Maojian Group Limited로 알려져 있었으며 2022년 4월에 China Zenith Chemical Group Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. China Zenith Chemical Group Limited는 1992년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 완차이에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
